about: Questions a fresh reviewer wrote from the backlog's review records without the owners' docs and without knowing how the ranking works, read by unit.query.OwnerParaphraseTest. OWNER-INDEX-3 tuned ranking ideas on it (refuted on owner-paraphrases-heldout-3.json and reverted), so it is held out no more. `owners` are the types whose answer it is (a member of one counts); `atLeast` is the floor the test holds. Never reword a question to fit a doc.

questions.question: Does this pretty-printer document end in a // line comment, so I must not glue the next token onto its line?
Which parts of a source file should be treated as comments or string text, so a name that only appears there does not count as a use when deciding an import is dead?
If some files were skipped because they would not parse, could any of them still mention this private member by name, so I should refuse to delete it?
Starting from a file, walk up its parent directories until a config file of a given name turns up.
In the formatter options code, how do I tell that an array literal is really a comprehension rather than a plain list?
Does this subtree only read a variable by name, as opposed to assigning to it?
Does a conditional-compilation line like #else, #end or a multi-line #if (a take a condition, and where does that condition end?
I need a finding's source text in a normalized form so that two occurrences can be compared for equality; what renders it?
What range of text has to be cut to delete or move a class member together with its doc comment, annotations and modifiers, so every operation agrees?
Given the text of `import a.b.Util as U`, get the path the alias points at.
Is this method called by name from a framework, like a Unity MonoBehaviour start, so that renaming it or making it private would break things?
Can I prove this operand is never null, so a null check on it is pointless?
Which node kind stands for the identifier inside a string interpolation such as '$Moved'?
Apply an edit to a source file and keep the result canonical, without shortening blank lines that sit inside a multi-line string literal.
Work out which token can start each alternative of a grammar rule, so the parser can dispatch on the first byte instead of trying every branch.
In the doc renderer, emit a line end followed by the right indentation.
